page_title: LEC 2-2 ACM | Lecce v AC Milan 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Lecce players look gutted.
90+7' The Lecce players halt their celebrations as referee Rosario Abisso makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.

90+4' It's in the back of the net! Wladimiro Falcone sends a long ball over and Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) takes a good touch to control it before unleashing a shot goalwards. His terrific effort surprised everyone when it ended up in the bottom left corner. The score has changed – 3:2.
90+4' Rade Krunic (AC Milan) tries to convince the referee to change his mind and receives a yellow card for dissent.
90+3' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) talks himself into the book for a second time and is sent off!
90+3' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) receives a yellow card for chasing the referee and shouting at him.

90+2' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
90+2' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) is given a yellow card.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' The game is interrupted. Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
89' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lameck Banda trots off the pitch and is replaced by Lorenzo Venuti (Lecce).
85' Booking. Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) receives a caution from the referee.
85' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the left post.
81' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
81' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) gets a yellow card, off the field.
80' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Rosario Abisso had an easy-decision to make.
80' Wasted opportunity! Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
79' A substitution has been made. Samuel Chukwueze goes off and Luka Jovic (AC Milan) comes on.
77' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) takes a shot from the free kick on the edge of the box and the ball sails inches wide of the right post. What a chance!
76' Poor challenge! Yunus Musah (AC Milan) is penalised for tripping and Rosario Abisso blows his whistle. Lecce earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
75' The total number of attempts is 9:10. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 5:6.
72' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
71' The yellow card is received by Rade Krunic (AC Milan).
71' Here is a change. Tommaso Pobega is going off and Stefano Pioli gives the last tactical orders to Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan).
70' 2 - 2 Goal - 2:2! Nicola Sansone tees up Lameck Banda (Lecce) inside the box and he curls the ball into the left side of the net and past Mike Maignan.
66' 1 - 2 Goal! The resulting corner is whipped into the box and Nicola Sansone (Lecce) buries the ball into the back of the net from a Alexis Blin knock down. 1:2.
66' The ball is out of play. Lecce will have a chance to score from a corner.
64' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Wladimiro Falcone easily deals with the threat.
63' It is time for a substitution. Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) is on for Nikola Krstovic.
63' Here comes a substitution. Nicola Sansone (Lecce) is brought on as a substitute for Gabriel Strefezza.
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Alexis Blin for Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
62' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) earns the yellow card.
61' A pass from Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is intercepted by Wladimiro Falcone and the move breaks down.
57' The substitution has been made. Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) has replaced Hamza Rafia.
53' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
52' Half-chance! Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) plays a pass into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone reacts well to snuff out the attack.
51' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Noah Okafor (AC Milan).
50' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Valentin Gendrey. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
48' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
47' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) gets inside the box and tries to beat Wladimiro Falcone with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
46' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
46' Stefano Pioli has made a change at the break. Yunus Musah (AC Milan) has come on in place of Davide Calabria.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

45' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) sends a lofted pass from the resulting free kick, but fails to hit the ball properly and his effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
45' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) will miss the next game.
45' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
44' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.

43' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for an infringement. AC Milan are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
39' What an opportunity! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) latches on to a perfect cross from the wing and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes narrowly over the crossbar!

39' Lameck Banda (Lecce) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Mike Maignan leaps like a salmon to deny him.

38' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball hits the right post and ricochets away.
35' 0 - 2 Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Wladimiro Falcone with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:2.
34' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
33' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
28' 0 - 1 GOAL! And it’s a scrappy one as Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) uses his body to force the ball into the net after a lofted pass.
27' 3:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 2:1.
24' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.

24' A neat pass is well received by Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.

23' Lameck Banda (Lecce) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Mike Maignan pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.

21' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
18' A corner kick by AC Milan is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).

18' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
15' Tommaso Pobega (AC Milan) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
14' A pass into the box finds Tommaso Pobega (AC Milan) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Wladimiro Falcone denies him.
13' A pass from Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) is intercepted by Mike Maignan and the move breaks down.
10' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is being substituted because of an injury. Stefano Pioli sends Noah Okafor on the pitch.
9' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
8' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post.
7' Half-chance! Lameck Banda (Lecce) plays a pass into the box, but Mike Maignan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
6' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
5' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) trips an opposition player and Rosario Abisso signals a foul. A free kick to Lecce.
4' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) attempts to find Tijjani Reijnders, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lecce will have the kick-off.
Rosario Abisso is introduced as the referee for today's match.
